title: Update a live chart by record ID
summary: Maintain a bounded window of incoming records, apply corrections, and reconcile the display after reconnecting.
job: Show incoming observations, keep the UI stable, and correct existing records without duplicates.
dataShape: Synthetic observations with stable IDs, numeric event time and value; a four-record retained window.
fit: Use when a React application needs ref-based updates and explicit record correction.
The host owns subscription lifecycle, replay and reconnection policy.
exclusions: Static SVG cannot establish subscription cleanup, correct replay or browser lifecycle behavior.
This simulated feed is not a production network protocol, durable queue or live service.

expected: Corrections replace records by stable ID without increasing the retained count.
At most four records remain in the chart after new observations.
While disconnected, the displayed window remains unchanged; reconnect replaces it with the current source window.
Unmount and StrictMode cleanup leave no active subscription or playback timer.
After all five events, retained IDs obs-03 through obs-06 have values 17, 20, 16 and 19.
unassessed: Real transport failures, server retention, clock synchronization and production backpressure.
Performance on physical devices or under a production event rate.

recovery.symptom: Pushed rows disappear when React renders again.
recovery.action: Omit data entirely in push mode. Push the initial window through the mounted ref; do not pass data={[]}.
recovery.recheck: Change host UI state and confirm that the retained records survive.

recovery.symptom: A correction cannot find a record or creates duplicates.
recovery.action: Set pointIdAccessor to id and use update(id, updater). On reconnect, replace the bounded window from the authoritative host snapshot.
recovery.recheck: Inspect the chart handle's data after correction and reconnect, including IDs, values and count.

continuation.rationale: The host needs explicit correction and reconnect behavior over a bounded observation window.
recheck: Cleanup, stable IDs, retention, data-prop omission and reconnect replacement after lifecycle or dependency changes.
continuation.loss: A static export records one window. It does not carry an active subscription, prove cleanup or promise future updates.

update.previousAssumption: A static render or an empty data array demonstrates a working live chart.
update.action: Omit data for push mode. Establish the subscription after the ref mounts, correct records by ID, clean up and reconcile from the authoritative window on reconnect.
recheck: Retained records and actual canvas paint through correction, disconnect, reconnect and restart.
Subscriptions and replay timers after unmount and StrictMode cleanup.
update.remaining: Production transport reliability and event-rate performance require their own environment-specific checks.
